category: paid-download file host (网赚网盘), free path

free_tier.stated: 100 GB on registration, per third-party documentation of the vendor's own signup copy: '免费注册即可得到：100G 网盘'. Downloads on the free path are the throttled, ad-bearing path the VIP tiers exist to bypass.

per_object_cap.stated: Not published for the free path; the paid page's 单文件最大 10GB is the only cap the vendor states.

retention.stated: '文件永不删除' is claimed on the paid page for the service as a whole.

egress.terms: Free downloads are throttled to tens of KB/s with ads and a wait. Third-party write-ups describe '几十KB/s，甚至几KB/s', which is the same order as 百度网盘's free path.

interface_detail: Browser; the returned URL is fetchable by a multi-threaded client.
chaining: Not a retrieval route for a user at any volume; recorded because the free path is what most links on this host actually resolve to.

limits.value: free download '几十KB/s' per third-party reporting

identity_cost.detail: Registration needed to upload and keep files; downloading a shared file needs no account. The signup fields were not read.

reliability_note: Same operator, same monetisation: the free path is deliberately slow because uploaders are paid per download.
confidence_note: Both are third-party. The vendor landing page publishes features only.

evidence.proved: landing page: '77File 云盘：稳定存储、极速下载、加密传输' - features only, no quota, no price
third party: '免费注册即可得到：100G 网盘', '通过下载量您将获得丰厚的回报'
third party: '下载速度只有几十KB/s，甚至几KB/s' on the free path

notes: Split from the VIP record because the two tiers differ in the thing that matters: one is the cheapest paid traffic, the other is unusable.
binding_note: A free pull at tens of KB/s cannot deliver a TiB in any month; the shaping is the wall and no byte counter exists to hit instead.
